scope: Selected awards of the Principality of Bulgaria (1878–1908), Kingdom of Bulgaria (1908–1946), and Republic of Bulgaria (1991–present); this is a partial pictured batch.
source_boundary: World Medals Index (medals.org.uk) text lists for Principality/Kingdom (30 entries), People’s Republic (81 linked entries), and Republic (8 entries). 36 object pages were opened; 20 complete front variants were downloaded and decoded. No People’s Republic object page was opened in this batch.
